reason: Bespoke scope-resolution cascade (path/PR/branch → staged → working-tree diff) distinct from the fable triage/tiers/closer payload; general-purpose reviewer, not a single-skill stack-review chassis.

The review-command chassis was retired on 2026-09-22 (panel finding #64): it rendered exactly ONE file in the whole marketplace — this one — behind a 24-line template, four partials and nine opt-out justifications, so the machinery cost more prose than the artifact it produced. The rendered output is inlined here and hand-maintained; the other four template families each render several files and earn their place.
